description:
Create a link tree page: a shareable page with the user's links (social media, portfolio, GitHub, etc.). Each account can create up to 10. The slug becomes the public URL. Slug rules: 5-20 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, cannot start/end with a hyphen. Must be unique. Use the user's name or handle as a base for the slug. The usual links are the ones on the user's profile (githubUrl, linkedinUrl, twitterUrl, url), which get_profile returns.

Remoet tracks views and link clicks on each link tree, so a link tree URL on a CV or application shows whether a recruiter opened it.

links.description: Array of links to display on the page (max 50)

slug.description: URL slug (5-20 chars, lowercase, hyphens allowed, must be unique)

name: create_linktree
title: Create Link Tree
